mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1100 units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1100, or correlation between HOUST and SPX returns falls below 0.2 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 5.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market fuels economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) when both conditions are met, or the mechanism's IC falls below 0.05 over any 18-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling improved supply chain efficiency, positively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism's walk-forward IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or SPX returns are not positively correlated with INDPRO growth (Pearson's r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger is met, or the mechanism's IC falls below 0.04 over any 24-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the CPI annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), signaling a tightening monetary policy, S&P 500 returns are negatively impacted over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict negative SPX returns in > 60% of instances when the trigger is met, or its walk-forward IC remains below 0.01 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the current unemployment rate (UNRATE) provides a persistent signal on the overall health of the economy, with lower rates consistently associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism's walk-forward IC falls below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window, or SPX returns are not negatively correlated with UNRATE (Pearson's r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% month-over-month, indicating strong consumer demand, and housing starts (HOUST) are above 1000 units, the combined effect fuels economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or the mechanism's IC falls below 0.02 over any 15-month window.
